question: What security and ownership boundary should the Dashboard browser preview use before implementation?
rationale: The feature would expose sensitive browser state and could live either as core Control UI or plugin-contributed UI; automation cannot safely choose that trust model.

options.title: Read-only-first admin panel
options.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs while requiring explicit user action for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submit actions.

options.title: Wait for plugin UI entry points
options.body: Defer browser-specific UI until the generic plugin UI entry-point contract lands and implement the browser surface as plugin-owned UI under that contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the current CLI/RPC screenshot workflow until remote browser preview becomes a prioritized product area.

recommendation.title: Read-only-first admin panel
recommendation.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs while requiring explicit user action for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submit actions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from the issue discussion and recent Control UI route/sidebar work.
